title: Let admins destroy regions
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Let admins destroy regions
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L1193: "The server SHOULD return `forbidden` when the caller is not the region owner and does not have deployment-defined administrative privileges."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/memory.rs:985-993; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/region.rs:559-574
Now: MemoryBackend::may_destroy_region allows only the owner, not admins. The handler doc and the error say 'only the region owner may destroy'.
Change: Allow admins in may_destroy_region (as may_update_region already does), and update the doc and description strings.
